text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, well! Mile Championship, we
meet at
last!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You bet it is! All that's left is to run my
heart out!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that reminds me. I oughta say howdy
to
Suzuka before the race starts.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...On second thought, maybe I better
not!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka's my pal... but today, she's the
rival I
wanna beat more than anybody.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: We'll leave the jawin' for after the race!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
choice_data_list: Let's make this the best race ever!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Just ya wait! You and Suzuka are gonna
be blown
away by my super-charged
running!
